facts.fact: The policy working group at the Africa BB Maps national event (ITU/EU project, hosted with ZICTA, Lusaka, 9-11 December 2025) concluded that Zambia lacks a national broadband policy and recommended formulating one.

note: Reports DERT 3 coverage, fibre and a K255 million quality-of-service approval, but names no national broadband plan, so nothing is tied to one.
States a presidential goal of connecting 800,000 Zambians to broadband by 2026 and the Digital Inclusion Roadmap, but names no national broadband plan or its adoption, funding or targets.

facts.fact: The Ministry of Technology and Science's National Digital Transformation Strategy 2023-2027 sets broadband targets, including national broadband coverage of 80 percent and average broadband speed from 2.73 to 5.00 mbps, and lists development of a national broadband master plan; the document gives no adoption date, so the start of its period, 2023, is used.

note: Carnegie's line lists the National ICT Policy 2023; it names no broadband plan.
